propositions: Core must compare only canonical shapes; vendor shapes cross the core solely as opaque payloads produced and consumed at port boundaries.
All eight vendor modules (acli*, adf, outbound_fields, comment_limits, and others) must be physically relocated into adapters/jira/ with loaders repointed and no re-export shims.

Zero vendor reach-through in core: no package-root src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/ module may import adapters.jira, use lazy-key literals for adapters.jira, or by-path load vendor paths, except inbound_fields.py.
Outbound and link differs must canonicalize snapshots via InboundMapper and build vendor payloads only via injected OutboundMapper at emission.
Scalar port surface (project, query_project, assert_env_ready, neutral BackendAssigneeNotFoundError) and rich-text/comment-limit paths must route through Backend protocols.
